title: New Jewish Canadian Party Leader Says ‘Jews of Conscience’ Stand Against Israel’s Genocide in Gaza
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
_**Editor 's Note: Avi Lewis is the husband of Zeteo contributor Naomi
Klein**._

The Jewish, anti-Zionist, democratic socialist recently
[elected](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/29/world/americas/canada-new-
democrats-party-leader-avi-lewis.html) to lead Canada's progressive [New
Democratic Party](https://www.ndp.ca/), **Avi Lewis** , is calling for a two-
way arms embargo against Israel, which he calls a "**rogue state**." He's also
pushing to recall ambassadors,
[cancel](https://x.com/avilewis/status/2057233136959074697) Canada's free
trade agreement with Israel, and issue a "**serious statement on the
international stage** " denouncing the country's genocide in Gaza.

In a riveting, can't-miss interview on 'Mehdi Unfiltered,' Lewis talks to
**Mehdi** about becoming anti-Zionist, something he calls a **" journey from
the propaganda, the pro-Israel myths that we were all brought up on**."

"**At this point in the genocidal period, I think it 's really, really clear
where Jews of conscience stand**," Lewis says, adding that the majority of
Jewish people in North America are "**deeply disturbed** " by Israel's
genocide.

Also during this fascinating interview, Mehdi and Lewis discuss:

  * How he plans to rebuild a party that now only has [five seats in Parliament](https://www.thestar.com/politics/federal/avi-lewis-not-fazed-as-ndps-lone-quebec-mp-quits/article_cb841a1e-4d0c-47f4-b233-79cfd314526f.html)

  * Why he [didn't run](https://halifax.citynews.ca/2026/04/27/ndp-leader-says-he-wont-run-in-quebec-byelection-as-boulerice-announces-departure/) in a recent by-election in Quebec

  * Prime Minister Mark Carney's "**mixed signals** " on Trump's war against Iran

  * Why an NDP MP recently [crossed the floor](http://google.com/search?q=lori+idlout+crosses+floor&sca_esv=5dd8999ec4cc0651&sxsrf=ANbL-n5ONqWnTDJseoKMG89eXsAbNEu7aA:1779473515952&ei=a5wQao3rOYfbptQP7pnq-AQ&start=10&sa=N&sstk=AU9db-BRHQhzB3rKmwmnYhKEV1pWNskR9Js2DbAOPcbv0Q97mle1EW8zBxmaSSvqQK6czQjLMICQd7uXMTiyLfMX1ruTI9NzQme7LA&ved=2ahUKEwjNzLi2v82UAxWHrYkEHe6MGk8Q8tMDegQIIBAE&biw=1441&bih=788&dpr=2) to join the Liberal Party

  * Losing his father, [Stephen Lewis](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/01/world/canada/stephen-lewis-dead.html), just two days after winning the leadership
